ocl.definition: def user : User = User.allInstance()->any(u | u.UserID = uid), bc: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(b | b.Barcode = barcode)
ocl.precondition: User.allInstance()->includes(user) and BookCopy.allInstance()->includes(bc) and user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and bc.Status = CopyStatus::AVAILABLE and bc.IsReserved = false
ocl.postcondition: let loan:Loan in loan.oclIsNew() and Loan.allInstance()->includes(loan) and loan.LoanedUser = user and loan.LoanedCopy = bc and bc.Status = CopyStatus::LOANED and user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and bc.LoanedRecord->includes(loan) and result = true
